description: This file is a Vitest configuration file, specifically configuring the testing environment for a frontend project using Vite. It merges default Vite test configurations with custom test setup, environment, and exclude patterns.

methods.name: mergeConfig
methods.description: Merges two Vitest configuration objects into a single configuration.

methods.name: defineConfig
methods.description: Defines Vitest configuration with proper typing support.

methods.name: configDefaults
methods.description: Provides default configuration values for Vitest, specifically used here to extend the exclude patterns.

methods.name: fileURLToPath
methods.description: Converts a file URL to a filesystem path, used here to resolve the root directory of the test suite.
